candidate_relations.reason: Biopsy showed invasive squamous carcinoma, while residual papules had dermoscopic features of basal cell carcinoma; the benchmark integrates both as basosquamous carcinoma. Partial metabolic response describes treatment response, not the complete tumor subtype.
candidate_relations.scope_detail: Identifies the squamous component and treatment-response state but omits the basal cell carcinoma component required for basosquamous carcinoma.
